# uve-harness

> Building software with agents as a Claude Code plugin: iterations of an incremental V-cycle, one agent per role, one gate, and rules a machine enforces.

## Start here
- [README](README.md): install, the cycle, roles and models, what the machine enforces
- [Rules for agents editing this repo](AGENTS.md): self-check, where rules live, OpenCode copies

## Skills
- [init](skills/init/SKILL.md): prepare a project (gate, integration branch, folders, AGENTS.md, llms.txt, `## Harness`)
- [iteration](skills/iteration/SKILL.md): plan, run and close one iteration; light vs full items; ledger; decisions
- [templates](skills/iteration/templates/): plan, requirements, brief, change note, checklist, close, decisions

## Agents
- [builder](agents/builder.md): one fix or feature, tests first, scope file, pull request
- [test-author](agents/test-author.md): blind acceptance tests from requirements and contracts
- [reviewer](agents/reviewer.md): scope, failing tests, gate, claims, reconciliation, merge into dev
- [designer](agents/designer.md): prototype, user approval, then views
- [assistant](agents/assistant.md): docs, scripts, counts, cleanup
- [devops](agents/devops.md): CI, containers, deploy, environments

## Machine rules
- [guard.py](scripts/guard.py): PreToolUse hook: secrets, gate and scope before a pull request, main
- [harness-gate](bin/harness-gate): run the gate, log the output, stamp the commit
- [harness-lane](bin/harness-lane): light or full from the diff
- [harness-scope](bin/harness-scope): branch changes against `.scratch/scope`
- [harness-trace](bin/harness-trace): every requirement named by a test
- [tests](tests/test.sh): self-check of all of the above

## Other runtimes and setup
- [setup.sh](setup.sh): install for Claude Code
- [setup-opencode.sh](setup-opencode.sh): install for OpenCode
- [opencode/harness.js](opencode/harness.js): OpenCode plugin running the guard
